haiku.problem: Isaiah's woe about adding house to house is a minor detail. The exile (1-11) or Sheol opening its jaws (1-14) are more central to the passage and were left out.

The wrong answer "He blew a trumpet" could be argued as right. The passage says the LORD lifts a banner to call the nations, and a trumpet is a similar signal, so this breaks the no-near-matches rule.
